data.title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 冥界花嫁的誓约·「连死亡都拆不散的契约」
data.description: 【想象场景】【冥界大圣堂·婚礼日】连神都很少踏足的冥界深处，今天亮起了婚礼的烛光。埃列什基伽勒披着白纱站在圣堂中央，金发王冠与白纱相映，红瞳里的泪光胜过所有魂火——「冥界的女王结婚……连死神都会来观礼的吧。这份契约的效力是——直到永远。连死亡，都拆不散哦。」
data.action: 白纱立于圣堂烛光中，金冠白纱相映红瞳含泪微笑
data.camera: wide shot, environmental portrait, underworld chapel bride, candle glow, sacred mood
data.promptProse: At the center of the underworld cathedral, Ereshkigal stands in an opaque white wedding gown and long veil beneath her golden tiara. Both hands hold a small bouquet of white flowers, leaving the formal silhouette calm and complete. Her red eyes shine with a relieved smile as candlelight mingles with the blue soul fires around the distant columns. In this imagined ceremony, she offers a quiet vow of companionship beyond death. Show the full gown, bouquet and veil within the vertical frame. No lettering.
